Risk Title & Description: Automated Bot Order Spam on Public Checkout Endpoint
Mitigation Implemented: Implemented hidden honeypot field (companyUrl), 1.2s rapid submission check, and input length sanitization on CheckoutPage.jsx.

Risk Title & Description: Administrative Authorization Reliant on Firestore Document Reads
Mitigation Implemented: Rules strictly check /databases/$(database)/documents/admins/$(request.auth.uid).isActive == true; arbitrary writes to /admins blocked.

Risk Title & Description: Transactional Email Delivery via Webhook Parameter Payload
Mitigation Implemented: Added deep payload sanitization (length truncations, string casts) and 10s AbortController timeout in emailService.js.
npm overrides lock vulnerable transitive dependencies (nth-check ^2.1.1, postcss ^8.4.32); production build compiles cleanly without warnings.

Risk Title & Description: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) from Aspect Ratio Shifts in Image Delivery
Mitigation Implemented: Added explicit width and height dimension attributes (width=400, height=320/384) to all catalog image cards in Gallery, Seasonal, Cupcakes, Cookies, Catering.

Risk Title & Description: Degraded Mobile Network Handling During Order Placement
Mitigation Implemented: Implemented navigator.onLine offline check in CheckoutPage.jsx to prevent stalled submissions and preserve cart items with actionable user alerts.

Risk Title & Description: Search Engine Crawler Discovery of Newly Published Catalog Products
Mitigation Implemented: public/sitemap.xml catalogs all canonical routes; public/robots.txt references sitemap; Vercel rewrites bypass static XML assets.

Risk Title & Description: Absence of Centralized Error Tracking in Production
Mitigation Implemented: Implemented GlobalErrorBoundary in App.js catching runtime exceptions with a branded recovery UI and reload trigger.
